items.zh: 这个会能改到明天下午吗？
items.scene: 客户临时有事，助理打电话商量改期

answers.en: Could we push the meeting to tomorrow afternoon?
answers.note: push 是口语里常用的“往后挪”，语气委婉，对客户或上级都合适。

answers.en: Could we move the meeting to tomorrow afternoon?
answers.note: move 最中性，只问能不能改时间，同事之间沟通时用最省事。

answers.en: Would tomorrow afternoon work for the meeting?
answers.note: 把重点放在时间是否合适，语气更客气，适合对方日程排得很满时。

items.zh: 会上你能把这点再讲清楚吗？
items.scene: 听不太懂同事的汇报，在会上插话

answers.en: Could you walk me through that part again?
answers.note: walk me through 指一步步讲清流程，适合对方讲的是步骤或方案。

answers.en: Can you clarify that point?
answers.note: clarify 偏正式，直接要求把某一点说明白，适合对方讲得含糊时。

answers.en: Sorry, I didn't quite follow — could you go over that again?
answers.note: 先承认自己没跟上再请求重复，语气缓和，适合会议中途打断。

items.zh: 会议纪要谁来写？
items.scene: 会议快结束时，项目负责人问团队

answers.en: Who's taking the minutes?
answers.note: take the minutes 是会议记录的标准说法，简短直接，团队内部常用。

answers.en: Who's going to write up the meeting notes?
answers.note: write up 强调会后整理成文，说法口语，适合非正式的小团队。

answers.en: Should we assign someone to take notes?
answers.note: 用提议代替直接点名，避免让某个人尴尬，适合还没分工的时候。

items.zh: 这个报价有效期到什么时候？
items.scene: 收到供应商报价单，采购在电话里确认

answers.en: How long is this quote valid for?
answers.note: 问有效期有多长，采购和销售沟通都常用，不特指某一天。

answers.en: When does this quote expire?
answers.note: 问具体到期日，比问时长更明确，适合准备签约前最后确认。

answers.en: Is this price still good after Friday?
answers.note: 用 price still good 的口语问法，带上时间点，适合催对方尽快确认。

items.zh: 能给我一个更优惠的价格吗？
items.scene: 老客户续约前，跟销售经理谈价格

answers.en: Could you do any better on the price?
answers.note: do better 是委婉砍价，不点明具体数字，给对方留谈判空间。

answers.en: Is there any room on the price?
answers.note: room 指让价余地，语气专业，适合正式谈判或长期合作。

answers.en: Can you give us a better rate?
answers.note: rate 偏服务或长期报价，直接但礼貌，老客户开口比较自然。

items.zh: 这个价格包含运费吗？
items.scene: 准备下单，向供应商确认报价细节

answers.en: Does this price include shipping?
answers.note: 最直接问是否含运费，适合美国国内订单的日常确认。

answers.en: Is shipping included in the quote?
answers.note: 用 quote 指报价单，说法偏正式，适合书面或采购流程。

answers.en: Are we looking at the total price with delivery?
answers.note: 口语化，暗示想要含配送的到手价，适合电话里谈。

items.zh: 合同什么时候能签？
items.scene: 项目等开工，经理催法务推进合同

answers.en: When can we get the contract signed?
answers.note: get something done 强调推动完成，适合内部催法务进度。

answers.en: What's the timeline for signing the contract?
answers.note: timeline 偏项目管理，问的是整体时间安排，适合正式对接。

answers.en: Any idea when the contract will be ready to sign?
answers.note: Any idea 让语气变软，适合不想显得催得太紧时用。

items.zh: 合同里这一条能改吗？
items.scene: 审合同时发现付款条件不合理，问对方律师

answers.en: Can we change this clause?
answers.note: 最直接，clause 指合同条款，适合逐条讨论时当场提出。

answers.en: Would you be open to revising this clause?
answers.note: be open to 是礼貌协商用语，暗示愿意谈，适合对对方律师。

answers.en: Is there any flexibility on this term?
answers.note: flexibility 强调弹性，不直接要求改，语气更圆滑，适合僵持时。

items.zh: 合同价里包含税吗？
items.scene: 财务核对合同金额，问对接的销售

answers.en: Does the contract price include tax?
answers.note: 标准财务问法，清楚指向合同价，适合正式核对金额。

answers.en: Is that figure before or after tax?
answers.note: 用 before or after 二选一，避免对方含糊回答，适合电话确认。

answers.en: Is that number with tax included?
answers.note: 口语里常见的追问方式，重复对方说的数字再问口径，适合快速核对。

items.zh: 发票什么时候能开出来？
items.scene: 报销快截止，员工催财务开票

answers.en: When will the invoice be ready?
answers.note: 最中性的问法，只问什么时候能拿到，适合日常催财务。

answers.en: How soon can you issue the invoice?
answers.note: issue 是开票的正式动词，适合对供应商或客户财务说。

answers.en: Any chance the invoice can be sent today?
answers.note: Any chance 委婉催当天，带一点着急，适合报销截止前。

items.zh: 发票上的公司名能改一下吗？
items.scene: 收到发票发现抬头不对，打电话给供应商

answers.en: Could you fix the company name on the invoice?
answers.note: fix 口语直接，说明要改哪里，适合第一时间打电话沟通。

answers.en: Could you reissue the invoice with the correct company name?
answers.note: reissue 指重新开票，比 fix 正式，适合写邮件提出。

answers.en: There's a mistake in the billing name — can you correct it?
answers.note: billing name 指发票抬头，先指出错误再请求更正，语气平稳。

items.zh: 截止日期能往后延两天吗？
items.scene: 方案还没改完，跟客户商量延期

answers.en: Could we push the deadline back by two days?
answers.note: push back 是延期常用说法，by two days 明确幅度，语气商量。

answers.en: Would it be possible to extend the deadline by two days?
answers.note: extend 更正式，适合邮件里向客户提出，显得有分寸。

answers.en: Can we get a two-day extension?
answers.note: 名词 extension 简洁，偏项目管理说法，适合对内部或对接人。

items.zh: 最快什么时候能交付？
items.scene: 客户急着上线，问供应商最快排期

answers.en: What's the earliest you can deliver?
answers.note: 直接问最早交付时间，适合客户催排期，重点落在速度。

answers.en: How soon can we get this delivered?
answers.note: 用 we 拉近关系，语气合作，适合长期供应商之间沟通。

answers.en: What does your fastest turnaround look like?
answers.note: turnaround 指交付周期，专业说法，适合正式询价或比价。

items.zh: 周五的截止日期还赶得上吗？
items.scene: 项目例会上，组长问团队进度

answers.en: Can we still make the Friday deadline?
answers.note: make the deadline 是赶截止日的常用搭配，问得直接，适合内部确认。

answers.en: Are we going to be able to hit Friday?
answers.note: hit 口语里指赶上日期，带一点压力，适合团队内部催进度。

answers.en: Is Friday still realistic for us?
answers.note: realistic 指现实可行，暗示可能来不及，适合做风险评估时。

items.zh: 你收到我的邮件了吗？
items.scene: 发了重要方案没回音，打电话问同事

answers.en: Did you get my email?
answers.note: 最口语的问法，适合熟同事，重点只是确认有没有收到。

answers.en: Have you had a chance to look at my email?
answers.note: 委婉，暗含请对方抽空看一下，适合对上级或客户。

answers.en: Just checking — did my email come through?
answers.note: come through 指邮件成功送达，先铺垫 just checking，语气轻松。

items.zh: 能确认一下明天的安排吗？
items.scene: 会前一天，助理跟客户核对流程

answers.en: Could you confirm tomorrow's schedule?
answers.note: confirm 正式，直接请对方确认，适合助理对客户。

answers.en: Can we run through tomorrow's plan?
answers.note: run through 指过一遍，带核对细节的意思，比 confirm 更口语。

answers.en: Just to confirm — we're still on for tomorrow, right?
answers.note: be on for 指约定照旧，用反问确认，语气亲切，适合熟客户。

items.zh: 这几个数字你核对过了吗？
items.scene: 提交方案前，请同事复核关键数据

answers.en: Have you double-checked these numbers?
answers.note: double-check 强调再核对一遍，适合同事之间提醒关键数据。

answers.en: Can you verify these figures before we send it out?
answers.note: verify 偏正式、流程化，适合文件发出前的最后确认。

answers.en: Are these numbers good to go?
answers.note: good to go 是口语里“可以了”的意思，轻松，适合关系近的同事。

items.zh: 这封邮件要抄送财务吗？
items.scene: 发付款邮件前，问主管要不要抄送财务

answers.en: Should I CC Finance on this email?
answers.note: Should I 是请示的常用说法，简短清楚，适合问主管。

answers.en: Do you want me to copy Finance on this?
answers.note: 更口语，把决定权交给对方，适合同事之间确认。

answers.en: Would Finance need to be looped in on this?
answers.note: loop in 指让某人知情并参与，语气正式，适合流程不清时。

items.zh: 这封邮件是不是抄错人了？
items.scene: 收到不相关邮件，回信提醒不熟的同事

answers.en: I think I was copied by mistake — I'm not handling this.
answers.note: by mistake 指出误抄，带缓冲，适合不熟的同事，不留指责感。

answers.en: Could you take me off this thread? I'm not the owner.
answers.note: take me off this thread 是请把自己移出邮件串，直接高效，适合邮件多时。

answers.en: Just to check — was I supposed to be on this email?
answers.note: 用反问确认而不是断言，语气最轻，适合不想让对方难堪。

items.zh: 附件用什么格式发给你？
items.scene: 客户要方案文件，问对方接收格式

answers.en: What format works best for the attachment?
answers.note: works best 问对方最方便的格式，语气客气，适合对接客户。

answers.en: Would you prefer the file as a PDF or a Word doc?
answers.note: 给出两个具体选项，减少来回，适合快速确认。

answers.en: Should I send it as a PDF?
answers.note: 直接提一个默认选项让对方确认，最省事，适合熟悉的客户。

items.zh: 附件好像打不开，能再发一份吗？
items.scene: 客户来电说文件有问题，助理处理

answers.en: The attachment won't open — could you resend it?
answers.note: won't open 描述文件打不开，直接请求重发，适合邮件或电话。

answers.en: I'm having trouble opening the file you sent. Could you send it again?
answers.note: have trouble doing 更委婉，先说自己这边的问题，适合对客户。

answers.en: Could you try sending it in a different format? The file isn't opening on my end.
answers.note: 提出换格式的解决办法，on my end 指自己这边，偏技术沟通。

items.zh: 客户那边还有问题吗？
items.scene: 提交方案两天后，销售向对接人打听反馈

answers.en: Does the client have any questions about the proposal?
answers.note: 中性询问，适合正式跟进，重点在是否还有疑问。

answers.en: Any feedback from the client so far?
answers.note: 口语省略句，问整体反馈而不只问题，适合熟悉的同事。

answers.en: Is the client okay with everything so far?
answers.note: 用 okay with 探询是否满意，语气轻松，适合关系近的对接人。

items.zh: 客户那边什么时候能给答复？
items.scene: 方案交上去一周没消息，销售问对接人

answers.en: Any word from the client yet?
answers.note: Any word 是问消息的简短口语，适合熟人同事之间跟进。

answers.en: Have you heard back from the client?
answers.note: hear back 指收到回复，标准说法，适合稍正式一点的跟进。

answers.en: Do we have a response from the client on the proposal?
answers.note: response 更正式，明确指方案的答复，适合写邮件询问。

items.zh: 合作方案你们那边什么时候能定？
items.scene: 等对方内部审批，项目经理打电话催

answers.en: When will your team be able to sign off on the partnership plan?
answers.note: sign off on 指正式批准，语气正式但不说死，适合对合作方。

answers.en: How soon can you get the partnership plan approved?
answers.note: approve 直接问审批完成时间，偏内部流程，适合催进度。

answers.en: Any update on your end about the partnership plan?
answers.note: 用 update 委婉催，不直接问时间，适合不想给对方压力时。

items.zh: 这次我们两家公司一起做，分工怎么定？
items.scene: 合作项目启动会，双方负责人谈分工

answers.en: How should we split the work between our two companies?
answers.note: split the work 直白问分工，适合启动会当场讨论。

answers.en: What's the best way to divide responsibilities on this?
answers.note: divide responsibilities 更正式，适合书面沟通或对上级。

answers.en: Who's handling what on this project?
answers.note: 口语短句，逐个确认负责范围，适合团队内部快速对齐。
